name: RV There Yet?
notes: Unreal Engine 5. The game picks DirectX 12 by default, which fails under Wine: forced to DirectX 11 with -dx11. With DXVK + MoltenVK the 3D scene stays black (MoltenVK has no geometry shaders and lacks typed storage image formats). With the optional DXMT engine (Direct3D 11 -> Metal, Scripts/build-dxmt-engine.sh, docs/DXMT.md) the 3D scene is drawn and a first solo run of about 6 minutes in the map ended cleanly (2026-11-08, M4 16 GB). Without that engine Stirred falls back to DXVK. Multiplayer (Epic Online Services) is not working yet: the session creation times out.
